text:
marta: Hey team — onboarding bug in ruby sampleapp: during `bundle install` users see a deprecation/post-install warning that confuses them into thinking the gem failed. Also when the demo rotates tokens, streaming reconnects 401. Logs and repro below.

ashwin: paste the log?

marta: sure:
```
Fetching redwood-sdk 0.12.0
Installing redwood-sdk 0.12.0 with native extensions
Post-install message from redwood-sdk:
DEPRECATION: precompiled platform gems will be removed in v0.13
WARN: credential helper fallback enabled; bundle exec may not pick up REFRESH_TOKEN
=> ERROR: failing to write C:/Users/alice/.bundle/credentials: permission denied
```

leo: hmm looks like two separate UX issues: the installer post-install note + Windows file permissions. The 401 on reconnect sounds like token refresh integration missing from streaming client.

marta: repro steps: windows 10, ruby 3.2, run sampleapp quickstart, then run `rails s` then trigger streaming example. After token rotation we get 401 and stream ends. The sampleapp uses ENV refresh token + a small refresh helper in README.

ashwin: can you paste the minimal code for the refresh helper?

marta:
```
def auth_header
  token = ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN']
  "Bearer #{token}"
end
# used by streaming client
client.start(auth: auth_header)
```

ashwin: problem is that the sampleapp builds auth header once during client init. When token rotates the client doesn't call the refresh proc. We recommend passing a lambda to the client so it can call on reconnect. E.g.:
```
client = Redwood::Client.new(auth: -> { "Bearer #{ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN']}" })
```

leo: for the bundler post-install: we should remove the post-install message, and instead log deprecation on runtime or put it in CHANGELOG. Also the permission error: sampleapp docs should advise creating `%USERPROFILE%/.bundle` or using `bundle config set path ...` on Windows.

marta: thanks. I'll open a small PR: remove postinstall message, add README note for Windows credential file and update sampleapp to pass lambda for auth. Also add a unit test for streaming reconnect behavior.

ci-bot: @marta created PR #4273: github.com/redwood/inference/ruby-sdk/pulls/4273 — add streaming auth lambda + README note. CI queued.

devex-bot: quick ask — can we also add a tiny e2e for token rotation in `sampleapps/ci`? Flaky but valuable.

leo: yes please. @ashwin can you review the PR and comment on test approach? Also flag for release notes.

ashwin: will review today. For tests, mock the auth provider and simulate rotate + reconnect; avoid flakiness by not depending on actual network.

marta: updated PR with a mocked reconnect test and Windows README snippet. PTAL.

ashwin: lgtm, left one nit about wording. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks! merging after CI. :rocket:
